title: Renew water-pump bearings and seals
completeness: Complete bounded bench operation from the declared entry state to the declared exit state. Whole-bike access and downstream engine closure are separate dependencies.

source.review_note: All cited operation pages visually reviewed. General symbols and conditional torque rules retained.

applicability.included: Exact US2026 YZ450F standard stock components only

required_tools.name: Bearing press and parallel outer-race drivers
Seal driver, circlip tools and torque wrench accurate at10Nm

required_parts.name: Two new pump bearings, new oil seal and rear shaft circlip
Two new housing/cover O-rings and coolant-drain washer
Exact intact impeller-shaft assembly if required

preflight: Right crankcase cover removed; oil/coolant drained.
Impeller-shaft assembly retained intact; replace it as an exact assembly if defective.
entry_state: Right crankcase cover removed; oil/coolant drained.
Impeller-shaft assembly retained intact; replace it as an exact assembly if defective.
exit_state: Water pump closed on right cover with renewed bearings/seals; right-cover installation and coolant commissioning remain.
critical_stop_conditions: Any required measurement unresolved or replacement criteria not satisfied.
Unidentified diagram orientation, missing parts, damage or abnormal binding.

material_policy.LT: Locking agent (LOCTITE) per PDF7. Grade unspecified by this manual; no grade inferred.
material_policy.lubrication: Follow each explicit E/M/LS/S application; general dry torque does not override a lubricated joint.

steps.title: Confirm water-pump bench access
steps.instruction: Oil and coolant are drained and the right crankcase cover is removed. Support the cover so pump-shaft and seal removal cannot damage its mating face. This guide renews bearings/seal and retains the intact impeller-shaft assembly unless that assembly is defective.
verification: Removed right cover and drained state confirmed.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Remove pump cover and shaft assembly
steps.instruction: Remove pump-cover bolts and coolant-drain bolt/washer. Lift cover and remove its O-ring and two dowels. Remove the rear shaft circlip and withdraw the complete impeller-shaft assembly. Remove the pump housing and its O-ring. Keep the two impellers and shaft assembled together for this route.
verification: Cover, two dowels, housing and intact shaft assembly accounted for.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Inspect the removed pump
steps.instruction: Inspect cover, housing, impeller shaft and both impellers for cracks, damage or wear; replace defective parts with exact stock components. Rotate bearing inner races by finger; roughness or seizure requires replacement. Unusual coolant loss/discoloration or milky engine oil calls for oil-seal removal; a removed seal cannot be reused.
verification: Pump-part condition and bearing observations saved.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Remove the old bearings and seal
steps.instruction: Remove the old oil seal and the two bearings from the supported right cover. Discard the removed bearings and seal. Protect the bores and mating surface; use the press and bearing-driver operation described for the engine bearings rather than hammering the cover.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Install the new pump seal
steps.instruction: Apply lithium-soap grease to the new seal lip. Point its illustrated projections outward and install parallel to0mm indicated depth. Keep its spring in place and avoid cutting the lip.
verification: Outward projections,0mm depth and intact spring/lip recorded.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Install both new bearings
steps.instruction: Oil the bearings and press them parallel by their outer races to the0mm indicated seated positions. Verify smooth inner-race movement after seating.
verification: Two new bearings seated0mm and moving smoothly.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Refit housing and intact impeller assembly
steps.instruction: Grease the new housing O-ring with lithium-soap grease. Install it, the pump housing and the intact serviceable impeller-shaft assembly, protecting the seal lip and spring. Fit a new rear circlip fully into its groove.
verification: New housing O-ring and rear clip installed; shaft/impellers serviceable.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Close the pump
steps.instruction: Fit both dowels and the new cover O-ring with lithium-soap grease. Refit the pump cover and tighten its bolts10Nm. Fit a new drain washer and tighten coolant-drain bolt10Nm. Final coolant fill/leak checks follow engine cover/engine installation.
verification: New cover O-ring, two dowels, cover10Nm and drain10Nm saved.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

runtime_integration_requirement: Enforce entry state and record_required. Completion certifies this bounded operation only; no automatic completion of upstream/downstream work.
